Vaccines with Diluents: How to Use Them

Be sure to reconstitute (mix) the following vaccines correctly before administering them! Reconstitution means that the Iyophilized (freeze-dried) vaccine powder in one vial must be mixed with the diluent (liquid) in another.

• Only use the diluent provided by the manufacturer for that vaccine as indicated on the chart. • ALWAYS check the expiration date on the diluent and vaccine. NEVER use expired diluent or vaccine. • Never freeze diluents.
